title: Clinic hours
text: The clinic is open Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00, and closed on weekends and public holidays. Appointments run from 9:00 to 17:00.

title: Cancellations and missed appointments
text: Patients should cancel at least 24 hours before the appointment. Front desk records late cancellations and no-shows in the appointment record. After three no-shows in 12 months, the practice manager contacts the patient.

title: Booking and rescheduling
text: Front desk books and reschedules appointments. Annual physicals are 30 minutes, follow-up visits 15 minutes, consultations 30 minutes. Urgent same-day requests go to the triage nurse.

title: Claim statuses
text: A claim marked CLOSED has no balance left for the patient. BILLED means the patient has been sent a statement and has an outstanding balance. Billing staff answer questions about balances; clinical staff do not discuss charges.

title: Payment plans
text: Patients with a balance over 200 dollars may ask billing for a payment plan of up to 6 monthly payments. Billing records the plan in the patient's account.

title: Prescription refill requests
text: Front desk takes refill requests and sends them to the prescribing clinician; they never approve refills. Requests are answered within 2 business days. Staff must not suggest doses or substitutes.

title: Releasing medical records
text: Copies of records are released only with a signed authorization from the patient or their legal representative. Verify identity with two identifiers, such as full name and date of birth, before discussing any record.

title: Minimum necessary access
text: Staff see only the information their role needs. Front desk sees contact details and appointments; billing sees claims; nurses see visits and medications. Do not look up patients you are not working with.

title: Urgent-risk protocol
text: If a patient may harm themselves or others, tell the on-call clinician immediately and do not leave the person alone. If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911. Record what happened after the person is safe.

title: New patient registration
text: New patients complete the registration form, provide photo ID and insurance details, and sign the privacy notice before their first visit. Front desk creates the patient record.
